derivation:
by
  apply Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  ext F; simp [pushforwardCompIso]; erw [Category.comp_id]
explanation: This specializes Mathlib’s associativity coherence theorem to the sheaf pullback–pushforward adjunctions. The required pushforward coherence follows by routine extensionality and simplification.
